# Test: grove add skips preserved files that would escape through a symlink
setup_workspace

cp $WORK/grove-toml .grove.toml
cp $WORK/gitignore .gitignore
exec git add .grove.toml .gitignore
exec git commit -m 'add grove config and gitignore'

# Commit a symlink at a directory path on a new branch
exec git checkout -b symlink-branch
mkdir $WORK/outside
symlink config -> $WORK/outside
exec git add config
exec git commit -m 'commit config symlink'

# Return to the source branch, where config is a real directory
exec git checkout main
mkdir config normal
cp $WORK/dot-env config/.env
cp $WORK/dot-env normal/.env

exec grove add symlink-branch
stderr 'Created worktree at .*[/\\]symlink-branch'
stderr 'Skipping preserved file config[/\\]\.env: cannot create its directory in the worktree:'
exists ../symlink-branch/normal/.env
! exists $WORK/outside/.env

-- grove-toml --
[preserve]
patterns = [".env"]

-- gitignore --
config/
normal/

-- dot-env --
SECRET=value
